name: article-writer
description: Give a topic, audience, intention, angle, and points to cover; article-writer researches it, checks facts, drafts it, and iterates with you conversationally until you're happy, then writes the final formatted article (plus a scope record) into one folder.

output_root.title: Runs root directory
output_root.description: Absolute path to the directory where article-writer stores every run's folder. Each run gets exactly one folder here (containing scope.md + article.md once published). Use forward slashes (e.g. C:/Users/you/OneDrive/ArticleWriterRuns) since the scripts run under bash. Leave blank to use the current working directory. The directory is created if it does not already exist.

audience.title: Default audience
audience.description: Fallback audience if you don't specify one when starting a run.

tone.title: Default tone / voice
tone.description: Fallback register and formality if you don't specify one when starting a run.

length.title: Default length / format target
length.description: Fallback length if you don't specify one when starting a run (e.g. short, medium, long, or a word count).

post_category.title: Default post category
post_category.description: Optional hint for how much research a run does by default if you don't say otherwise per run (e.g. musings, learnings, movies, books, photos, travel, mba). Leave blank to decide per run.
